exercise.name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
steps: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Snap your hips forward to bring it up to rest on your forearm.
Press it straight overhead, then lower it to your shoulder and the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.
exercise.one_line_summary: One kettlebell, one hand. Start: bell on the floor between wide feet, hips back and down in a hinge (trunk ~65 deg forward, flat back), arm straight to the handle. End: standing tall, arm locked overhead, bell resting on the back of the forearm. Front delts are the target; triceps, glutes and hamstrings help.

setup.target: Bell between the feet, feet wide, hinge with a flat back.
setup.why: Library step 1; kettlebell lifts from the floor use a hip-hinge squat pattern (S3).

movement.path: Hips snap forward to clean the bell (library step 2), then stand tall.

movement.start: ~59 deg in the torso frame (arm hanging to the handle)

muscles.emg: Anterior deltoid works in the kettlebell press, a little more than with a dumbbell (S2); measured in the one-arm clean (S1).

muscles.surface: Back of the upper arm, shoulder to elbow.

muscles.emg: ~80% MVC in kettlebell hinge lifts (S3); measured in the clean (S1).

muscles.role: Extends the hip with the glutes.
muscles.surface: Back of the thigh, buttock to knee.

mistakes.why_it_matters: Hinge lifts load the low back (S3); keep it flat.

sources.citation: Lyons BC, Mayo JJ, Tucker WS, Wax B, Hendrix RC. 2017. Electromyographical comparison of muscle activation patterns across three commonly performed kettlebell exercises. J Strength Cond Res 31(9):2363-2370. doi:10.1519/JSC.0000000000001771
sources.what_it_gave: One-arm kettlebell clean, swing and snatch are total-body lifts (anterior deltoid, gluteus maximus, biceps femoris, erector spinae, vastus lateralis measured).

sources.citation: Blazkiewicz M, Hadamus A. 2022. The effect of the weight and type of equipment on shoulder and back muscle activity in surface electromyography during the overhead press. Sensors 22(24):9762. doi:10.3390/s22249762
sources.what_it_gave: Kettlebell vs dumbbell overhead press: anterior/posterior deltoid, trapezius, serratus and erectors all work; kettlebell values always a little higher.

sources.citation: McGill SM, Marshall LW. 2012. Kettlebell swing, snatch, and bottoms-up carry: back and hip muscle activation, motion, and low back loads. J Strength Cond Res 26(1):16-27. doi:10.1519/JSC.0b013e31823a4063
sources.what_it_gave: Kettlebell lifts from the floor use a hip-hinge squat pattern: ~80% MVC gluteals and ~50% MVC low-back extensors with a 16 kg bell.
The steps the app shows; the pictures must match them.

clip_check.check: Start: fist round the handle, bell on the floor
End: arm locked overhead, bell behind the forearm, not cutting into it
